file_shape: { "db": { "<table>": [ {row}, ... ] } }  -- every value a string, "" for blank
id_rule: <contributor_prefix>-<dataset_namespace>-<TABLE_PREFIX>-<NNNN>; contributor_prefix = slug(email local)-slug(first domain label)-fnv1a32 base36 (3 chars); dataset_namespace = 6 random [0-9a-z]
curve_data_format: JSON string of [{"legend": str, "points": [{"x": num, "y": num}], "ordering": "xy"|"path"}]
